newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Leader eyes India's Incab - paper.
newsitem.headline: Leader eyes India's Incab - paper.

text.p: Malaysia's Leader Universal Holdings Bhd expects to conclude a deal to acquire India's Incab Industries Ltd before the end of the year, The Star reported on Friday.
Leader is expected to initially acquire a 10 percent stake in Incab which will involve an investment of about five million ringgit, the daily quoted a local source as saying.
Incab is involved in the manufacturing of telecommunication and power cables, businesses which Leader is also involved in.
"Incab will become the platform for Leader to venture into the Indian telecommunications and cable manufacturing sectors," the source was quoted as saying.
